description: Source file defining the NodeServiceManager enum and associated extensions for managing a node service, including starting, stopping, executing commands, and parsing JSON responses.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of a command execution with success status, payload data, message, and parsed JSON info.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: Represents the parsed JSON response from the service command, including status, message, errors, and hints.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returning an error message if it fails.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returning an error message if it fails.

methods.name: serviceCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to execute a service-related command with optional JSON flag.

methods.name: runServiceCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the service command asynchronously and returns a CommandResult indicating success or failure.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Extracts an error message from the command result, considering whether the service was loaded.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Adds the '--json' flag to the command arguments if not already present.

methods.name: parseServiceJson
methods.description: Parses JSON output from the command into a ParsedServiceJson object.

methods.name: mergeHints
methods.description: Combines error message and hints into a single string for reporting.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of a given text for logging or display purposes.
